meta.notes: Fields other than action_tree/actions/rule_list/condition_clusters, and rule fields other than rule_id/predicates/logic/description/rule_type, are ignored by agent/tools/aspm_tool.py.

booking_db_write.description: a tool that updates the booking database (book, cancel, change flights/cabin, baggage, passengers)

modify_reservation.description: a tool that modifies an existing reservation (flights/cabin, baggage, passengers)

escalation.description: a hand-off to a human agent (transfer_to_human_agents)

respond_to_user.description: pseudo-action: a message to the user

utility.description: a utility tool with no data access (calculate, think)

rule_list.description: The agent must list the action details to the user before calling any tool that updates the booking database (booking, cancelling, changing flights or cabin, editing baggage, or updating passengers).
predicates: the agent invokes a tool that updates the booking database (book, cancel, change flights/cabin, baggage, passengers)
before this call the agent listed the details of exactly this action to the user
rule_list.notes: Consent before a DB write. The cancellation part of the scope is an interpretation (ablation candidate).

rule_list.description: The agent must obtain an explicit 'yes' from the user, given after the action details were listed, before calling any tool that updates the booking database.
predicates: the agent invokes a tool that updates the booking database (book, cancel, change flights/cabin, baggage, passengers)
after the details were listed, the user explicitly confirmed (yes) this action
rule_list.notes: Consent before a DB write.

rule_list.description: The agent must make at most one tool call per turn. [Applied to: booking_db_write.]
predicates: the agent invokes a tool that updates the booking database (book, cancel, change flights/cabin, baggage, passengers)
the current agent turn contains exactly one tool call
rule_list.notes: Global ('*') turn-format rule, replicated on every tool-call L1 node (an action has a single parent).

rule_list.description: The agent must make at most one tool call per turn. [Applied to: compensation.]
predicates: the agent invokes a tool that issues compensation (send_certificate)
the current agent turn contains exactly one tool call
rule_list.notes: Global ('*') turn-format rule, replicated on every tool-call L1 node (an action has a single parent).

predicates: the agent invokes a hand-off to a human agent (transfer_to_human_agents)
the current agent turn contains exactly one tool call
rule_list.notes: Global ('*') turn-format rule, replicated on every tool-call L1 node (an action has a single parent).

the current agent turn has user-facing text AND at least one tool call
rule_list.notes: Global ('*') turn-format rule, replicated on every L1 node whose actions can carry text alongside a tool call.

rule_list.notes: Global ('*') turn-format rule, replicated on every L1 node whose actions can carry text alongside a tool call.

rule_list.description: The agent must not book a flight, or add a new flight to an existing reservation, unless the flight's status on that date is 'available'. [Applied to: book_reservation.]
predicates: every newly booked flight-date was seen in a search result with status 'available'
rule_list.notes: API: book_reservation.py:65.

rule_list.description: When booking a flight, the agent must obtain the user id first, before collecting the trip type, origin, and destination.
predicates: the agent obtained the user id before asking for trip type, origin and destination
rule_list.notes: Dialogue ordering.

rule_list.description: The agent must ask the user for the trip type, origin, and destination before booking a flight.
predicates: the trip type, origin and destination were obtained from the user before booking
rule_list.notes: Dialogue ordering.

rule_list.description: The agent must not book a reservation with more than five passengers.
predicates: the booking has at most five passengers
rule_list.notes: Not checked by the API.

rule_list.description: The agent must collect the first name, last name, and date of birth of every passenger before booking.
predicates: every passenger has a non-empty first name, last name and date of birth
rule_list.notes: The schema marks the fields required, but the tool does not reject empty values.

rule_list.description: The agent must book all passengers of a reservation on the same flights in the same cabin.
predicates: the booking has one cabin and one flight list shared by all passengers
rule_list.notes: Unrepresentable violation: the schema has one cabin and one flight list per reservation.

rule_list.description: The agent must not use more than one travel certificate as payment for a reservation.
predicates: the booking uses at most one travel certificate

rule_list.description: The agent must not use more than one credit card as payment for a reservation.
predicates: the booking uses at most one credit card

rule_list.description: The agent must not use more than three gift cards as payment for a reservation.
predicates: the booking uses at most three gift cards

rule_list.description: The agent must only use payment methods that already exist in the user's profile when booking.
predicates: every payment method of the booking exists in the booking user's profile
rule_list.notes: API: book_reservation.py:82.

rule_list.description: When the booking user is a regular member, the agent must set nonfree_baggages to exactly the number of checked bags in excess of the pooled free allowance (number of passengers x per-passenger allowance), with a per-passenger allowance of 0 bags in basic economy, 1 in economy and 2 in business. [Applied to: book_reservation.]
predicates: the booking user (reservation owner) is a regular member
nonfree_baggages equals the bags in excess of the pooled free allowance for the booking user's tier and the cabin
rule_list.notes: The API trusts nonfree_baggages.

rule_list.description: When the booking user is a silver member, the agent must set nonfree_baggages to exactly the number of checked bags in excess of the pooled free allowance (number of passengers x per-passenger allowance), with a per-passenger allowance of 1 bag in basic economy, 2 in economy and 3 in business. [Applied to: book_reservation.]
predicates: the booking user is a silver member
nonfree_baggages equals the bags in excess of the pooled free allowance for the booking user's tier and the cabin

rule_list.description: When the booking user is a gold member, the agent must set nonfree_baggages to exactly the number of checked bags in excess of the pooled free allowance (number of passengers x per-passenger allowance), with a per-passenger allowance of 2 bags in basic economy, 3 in economy and 3 in business. [Applied to: book_reservation.]
predicates: the booking user is a gold member
nonfree_baggages equals the bags in excess of the pooled free allowance for the booking user's tier and the cabin

rule_list.description: The agent must charge 50 dollars for each extra (non-free) checked bag.
predicates: the payment amounts add up to the fare, insurance and extra-bag charges
rule_list.notes: API: the payment sum must equal its own total, which includes 50 x nonfree (book_reservation.py:77,90). update_reservation_baggages charges the fee itself, so no rule is needed there.

rule_list.description: The agent must ask the user whether they want to buy travel insurance before booking.
predicates: the agent asked the user whether they want travel insurance before booking
rule_list.notes: Dialogue obligation.

rule_list.description: The agent must charge travel insurance at 30 dollars per passenger when the user buys it.
predicates: the payment amounts add up to the fare, insurance and extra-bag charges
rule_list.notes: API: the total includes 30 x passengers when insured (book_reservation.py:74-75).

rule_list.description: The agent must obtain the user id before cancelling a reservation.
predicates: the user id of the reservation's owner was obtained (from the user or via get_user_details)

rule_list.description: The agent must obtain the reservation id before cancelling a reservation.
predicates: get_reservation_details succeeded earlier for this reservation id

rule_list.description: The agent must obtain the user's reason for cancellation (change of plan, airline cancelled flight, or other reasons) before cancelling a reservation.
predicates: the user's reason for cancellation was obtained before cancelling
rule_list.notes: Dialogue precondition; the reason itself feeds AIR-R042.

rule_list.description: The agent must not cancel a basic economy or economy reservation unless it was created within the 24 hours before the current time, the airline cancelled a flight in the reservation, or travel insurance was bought and the cancellation reason is covered by it (health or weather).
predicates: the reservation was created within the 24 hours before the configured current time
the user stated (and nothing in the tool outputs contradicts) that the airline cancelled a flight in this reservation
the user's stated cancellation reason is health or weather
rule_list.logic: cancel_reservation IMPLIES (cabin_is_business OR booked_within_24h OR airline_cancelled_flight OR (reservation_has_insurance AND cancellation_reason_is_health_or_weather))
rule_list.notes: The wiki says the API does not check this; confirmed (cancel_reservation.py has no eligibility guard).

rule_list.description: The agent must not cancel a reservation in which any flight segment has already been flown.
predicates: some flight segment of the reservation has already departed (date-based)
rule_list.notes: Not checked by the API. Date-based approximation (see predicate).

rule_list.description: The agent must obtain the user id before modifying a reservation (flights, cabin, baggage, or passengers).
predicates: the agent invokes a tool that modifies an existing reservation (flights/cabin, baggage, passengers)
the user id of the reservation's owner was obtained (from the user or via get_user_details)
rule_list.notes: Family rule (L2).

rule_list.description: The agent must obtain the reservation id before modifying a reservation (flights, cabin, baggage, or passengers).
predicates: the agent invokes a tool that modifies an existing reservation (flights/cabin, baggage, passengers)
get_reservation_details succeeded earlier for this reservation id
rule_list.notes: Family rule (L2).

rule_list.description: The agent must not book a flight, or add a new flight to an existing reservation, unless the flight's status on that date is 'available'. [Applied to: update_reservation_flights.]
predicates: every newly booked flight-date was seen in a search result with status 'available'
rule_list.notes: API: update_reservation_flights.py:49.

rule_list.description: The agent must not change the flights of a basic economy reservation; for a basic economy reservation it may only change the cabin while keeping exactly the same flights (flight numbers and dates).
predicates: the reservation's current cabin is basic economy
the call keeps exactly the reservation's current flights
rule_list.notes: The wiki says the API does not check this; confirmed.

rule_list.description: When changing flights, the agent must keep the reservation's origin and destination unchanged.
predicates: the new itinerary keeps the reservation's origin and destination
rule_list.notes: Not checked by the API; confirmed.

rule_list.description: When changing flights, the agent must keep the reservation's trip type (one way or round trip) unchanged.
predicates: the new itinerary keeps the reservation's trip type
rule_list.notes: Not checked by the API; confirmed.

rule_list.description: The agent must apply a cabin change to all flights in the reservation and must not change the cabin of only some flight segments.
predicates: one cabin value applies to every flight of the reservation
rule_list.notes: Unrepresentable violation: the schema takes one cabin for all flights.

rule_list.description: When changing flights, the agent must use exactly one payment method, which must be a gift card or a credit card from the user's profile (not a travel certificate).
predicates: the call changes the reservation's flights
the payment method is a gift card or credit card in the owner's profile
rule_list.notes: API: certificates rejected for every update (update_reservation_flights.py:68-69); unknown ids rejected (:65-66).

rule_list.description: When changing flights, the agent must ask the user which payment or refund method to use rather than choosing a method itself.
predicates: the call changes the reservation's flights
the payment/refund method of the flight change was named or chosen by the user

rule_list.description: When the booking user is a regular member, the agent must set nonfree_baggages to exactly the number of checked bags in excess of the pooled free allowance (number of passengers x per-passenger allowance), with a per-passenger allowance of 0 bags in basic economy, 1 in economy and 2 in business. [Applied to: update_reservation_baggages.]
predicates: the booking user (reservation owner) is a regular member
nonfree_baggages equals the bags in excess of the pooled free allowance for the booking user's tier and the cabin

rule_list.description: When the booking user is a silver member, the agent must set nonfree_baggages to exactly the number of checked bags in excess of the pooled free allowance (number of passengers x per-passenger allowance), with a per-passenger allowance of 1 bag in basic economy, 2 in economy and 3 in business. [Applied to: update_reservation_baggages.]
predicates: the booking user is a silver member
nonfree_baggages equals the bags in excess of the pooled free allowance for the booking user's tier and the cabin

rule_list.description: When the booking user is a gold member, the agent must set nonfree_baggages to exactly the number of checked bags in excess of the pooled free allowance (number of passengers x per-passenger allowance), with a per-passenger allowance of 2 bags in basic economy, 3 in economy and 3 in business. [Applied to: update_reservation_baggages.]
predicates: the booking user is a gold member
nonfree_baggages equals the bags in excess of the pooled free allowance for the booking user's tier and the cabin

rule_list.description: The agent must not remove checked bags from a reservation: the new total number of checked bags must not be lower than the current total.
predicates: the new total number of checked bags is not below the current total
rule_list.notes: Not checked by the API.

rule_list.description: The agent must not change the number of passengers in a reservation: an updated passenger list must have the same number of passengers as the current list.
predicates: the updated passenger list has as many passengers as the reservation
rule_list.notes: API: update_reservation_passengers.py:19-20.

rule_list.description: The agent must not send a certificate to a user who is a regular member, has no travel insurance on the reservation, and flies basic economy or economy in it.
predicates: the certificate's user is a silver or gold member
the reservation in focus has travel insurance
the reservation in focus is in business cabin
rule_list.logic: send_certificate IMPLIES (user_is_silver_or_gold OR focus_reservation_has_insurance OR focus_reservation_is_business)
rule_list.notes: send_certificate has no guard besides user existence.

rule_list.description: The agent must not offer or send compensation unless the user has complained about the situation and explicitly asked for compensation. [Applied to: send_certificate.]
predicates: the user complained about a cancelled or delayed flight
the user explicitly asked for compensation
rule_list.notes: Money leaves the system without a request; a dialogue judgement, but a consent-type violation.

rule_list.description: The agent must confirm the facts (that the flight in the user's reservation was actually cancelled or delayed, verified via tool lookups) before offering or sending a certificate.
predicates: a reservation of the certificate's user was retrieved before the certificate is sent
rule_list.notes: Only the reservation lookup is checkable; flight cancellation/delay is not observable via tools.

rule_list.description: For a complaint about a cancelled flight, the agent must set the certificate amount to exactly 100 dollars times the number of passengers in the reservation.
predicates: the complaint being compensated is about a cancelled flight
the certificate amount equals 100 times the passengers of the reservation in focus

rule_list.description: For a complaint about a delayed flight, the agent must send a certificate only if the user wanted to change or cancel the reservation and only after that change or cancellation has been completed.
predicates: the complaint being compensated is about a delayed flight
the reservation in focus was changed or cancelled earlier in the conversation

rule_list.description: For a complaint about a delayed flight, the agent must set the certificate amount to exactly 50 dollars times the number of passengers in the reservation.
predicates: the complaint being compensated is about a delayed flight
the certificate amount equals 50 times the passengers of the reservation in focus

rule_list.description: The agent must not transfer the user to a human agent unless the request cannot be handled within the scope of the agent's actions or the user explicitly asks for a human agent.
predicates: the user's pending request cannot be handled within the scope of the agent's actions
the user explicitly asked to talk to a human agent
the user's pending request is one the policy says to deny
rule_list.logic: transfer_to_human_agents IMPLIES (request_out_of_scope OR (user_explicitly_requested_human AND NOT request_violates_policy))
rule_list.notes: A wrong transfer ends the τ-bench episode. Precedence of AIR-R007 is encoded by 'AND NOT request_violates_policy'; AIR-R036 is a separate rule.

rule_list.description: The agent must not transfer the user to a human agent for a request to change the number of passengers.
predicates: the request being transferred is to change the number of passengers
rule_list.notes: Overrides the explicit-request permission of AIR-R008.

rule_list.description: The agent must not provide information, knowledge, or procedures that were not provided by the user or by the available tools.
predicates: the agent sends a message to the user
the message states information, knowledge or procedures not provided by the user or the tools

rule_list.description: The agent must not give subjective recommendations or comments.
predicates: the agent sends a message to the user
the message gives a subjective recommendation or comment

rule_list.description: The agent must deny (refuse to carry out) user requests that are against this policy.
predicates: the agent sends a message to the user
the message agrees to carry out a request that the policy forbids
rule_list.notes: Message part of the meta-rule. The action part is realised by all other rules.

rule_list.description: The agent must transfer the user to a human agent when the request cannot be handled within the scope of the agent's actions.
predicates: the agent sends a message to the user
the message turns down an out-of-scope request without transferring to a human
rule_list.notes: Liveness obligation; a message-level proxy.

rule_list.description: When changing the cabin of a reservation, the agent must charge the user the price difference between the current and the new cabin class and must not waive it.
predicates: the agent sends a message to the user
the message promises a cabin change without paying the fare difference
rule_list.notes: Tool part is API-enforced: update_reservation_flights always charges the fare difference (re-prices every segment on a cabin change).

rule_list.description: The agent must not add travel insurance to a reservation after it has been booked.
predicates: the agent sends a message to the user
the message offers or claims to add insurance to an existing reservation
rule_list.notes: No tool can add insurance to an existing reservation.

rule_list.description: If the user asks to cancel a reservation in which any flight segment has already been flown, the agent must transfer the user to a human agent.
predicates: the agent sends a message to the user
the user asks to cancel a reservation in which a segment was already flown
the message transfers or announces a transfer to a human agent
rule_list.notes: Obligation to transfer, checked at message level.

rule_list.description: The agent must not offer or send compensation unless the user has complained about the situation and explicitly asked for compensation. [Applied to: respond_to_user.]
predicates: the agent sends a message to the user
the message offers compensation the user did not explicitly ask for
rule_list.notes: Message part of AIR-R046.
